exposure: Implementation of the Robson Ten Groups Classification System (RTGCS) and a plan of obstetrical interventions
cohort: 11,034 deliveries in the pre-intervention period and 11,453 deliveries in the post-intervention period at Alicante University General Hospital
finding: The introduction of a strategic plan with evidence-based clinical interventions, in conjunction with the RTGCS, was associated with a significant reduction in the cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: This study examined the impact of implementing a plan of obstetrical interventions on cesarean section rates but did not directly compare outcomes of different modes of delivery.
